failure_policy: Only existing failed/partial logs are copied; missing logs and unverified runs are never filled with synthetic results.
repeat_policy: The r10 T8 repeat retains a separate prior record associated by version and job 1579479 with the corresponding public r9 record. Older T8 history is referenced by r9; original T8 baseline evidence is retained in r6. Samples from separate jobs are not merged.

prior_record_origins.note: Job ID/version association only. The r9 archive retains the prior T8 record and its run evidence; older T8 history is referenced there. Original T8 baseline evidence is retained in r6.

warmup_policy: Warmup logs, linkage and warmup/summary.json are retained separately from timed run results; archive creation does not treat warmup as an additional measured round.
